modules.name: Logging Warning
modules.about: Raises Android's logging threshold to WARNING with reversible RAM-only properties.

modules.name: Wi-Fi ADB
modules.about: Starts authenticated ADB over TCP on port 5555; installs disabled.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Haptics MAIN
modules.about: Routes controller haptics to the grip motor with retuned pulse timing.

modules.name: GXR OpenXR QUALITY
modules.about: Holds the camera QUALITY request during visible OpenXR sessions with thermal guards.

modules.name: Galaxy XR OTA Control
modules.about: Blocks Samsung firmware updates and restores the saved package baseline.

modules.name: Galaxy XR MV-HEVC Eye Fix
modules.about: Fixes left/right eye inversion in Samsung Gallery MV-HEVC spatial video.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Controller Suite
modules.about: Whitening, timestamp precision, HAL cache bypass, tail velocity and HAL log control in one WebUI.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Framebuffer10
modules.about: Experimental 10-bit SDR compositor output with corrected colour; AZF3 only.

modules.name: Galaxy XR SystemUI Optimization
modules.about: Experimental duplicate-wait, selected-depth and hidden-panel fixes for SystemUI.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Steam Link Suite
modules.about: Deprecated suite that bundled Velocity Frame, Pose Time, OpenXR priority profiles and Controller Extrapolation.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Controller Extrapolation
modules.about: Stock consumer-side controller extrapolation inside Steam Link; retired.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Controller Timestamp Precision
modules.about: Kept controller pose timestamps at integer precision; now in Controller Suite.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Controller Whitening
modules.about: Corrected process-covariance whitening in Samsung's controller service; now in Controller Suite.

modules.name: Galaxy XR HAL Cache Bypass
modules.about: Recomputed controller poses instead of using the HAL predictor cache; now in Controller Suite.

modules.name: Galaxy XR OpenXR Velocity Frame
modules.about: Corrected controller velocity coordinates for OpenXR apps; was in the deprecated Steam Link Suite.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Steam Link Pose Time
modules.about: Forwarded real controller pose timestamps to Steam Link; was in the deprecated Steam Link Suite.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Stream CPU Relief
modules.about: HAL log level and Steam Link thread-priority relief; folded into the deprecated Steam Link Suite.

modules.name: Controller HAL Log Relief
modules.about: Internal Controller Suite component: HAL log level zero in private memory.

modules.name: OpenXR App Priority
modules.about: Internal Controller Suite component: profile-based OpenXR thread priorities.
